rendered.overview: [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] leads a five-color Ally and Lesson deck that chains airbend, waterbend, earthbend, and firebend triggers to draw cards and grow lands into creatures. Shrines and Lesson spells fuel the graveyard and card flow while [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] and friends tap down threats and blink permanents for discounts. Eventually [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] transforms into [[Aang, Master of Elements]], drawing four cards, gaining life, and dealing damage to every opponent.

strategy: Ramp early with artifacts and Lesson spells to reach five colors for [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]].
Cast Lesson spells to trigger bending abilities, filling the graveyard and drawing cards.
Use [[Toph, Hardheaded Teacher]] and earthbend effects to turn lands into attacking creatures.
Land all four bending triggers in a turn to transform [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] into [[Aang, Master of Elements]].
Close games with [[Aang, Master of Elements]]'s upkeep trigger dealing repeated damage to opponents.

Any hand with [[Sol Ring]] or [[Arcane Signet]] plus a land to follow it up.
sendBack: A hand with no way to fix colors for [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]].
A hand stuck on one color with no path to the other four.

rendered.overview: This Jeskai artifacts deck builds around [[Kilo, Apogee Mind]], whose proliferate trigger grows counters across the board every time it taps. Cheap artifacts come down early via affinity and improvise, feeding counter-based payoffs like [[Walking Ballista]], [[Astral Cornucopia]], and [[Inspirit, Flagship Vessel]]. Proliferate doublers such as [[Tekuthal, Inquiry Dominus]] accelerate the snowball, turning small counters into mana, cards, and damage that close out games while instants like [[Swords to Plowshares]] and [[Chaos Warp]] keep the board clear.

strategy: Deploy cheap artifacts to enable affinity, improvise, and metalcraft payoffs early.
Tap [[Kilo, Apogee Mind]] in combat or with abilities to trigger repeated proliferate.
Grow counters on [[Astral Cornucopia]], [[Walking Ballista]], and [[Inspirit, Flagship Vessel]] via proliferate.
Convert accumulated counters into mana, cards, and damage to close out the game.
Use [[Swords to Plowshares]], [[Chaos Warp]], and counterspells to protect the board state.

sendBack: [[Sol Ring]] with nothing to cast after it stalls out.
A hand clogged with high-cost proliferate payoffs and no early plays.

Casting [[Astral Cornucopia]] then [[Deepglow Skate]] doubles its charge counters for a burst of mana.

rendered.overview: A colorless-only deck built around [[Zhulodok, Void Gorger]], ramping hard into huge artifacts and Eldrazi so every spell costing 7 or more cascades twice into free value. It wins by grinding opponents out with repeated Annihilator triggers, board wipes, and card advantage until a giant Eldrazi or two finish the job.

strategy: Ramp through artifact mana rocks and colorless lands to reach seven-plus mana quickly.
Cast [[Zhulodok, Void Gorger]] to turn big colorless spells into double cascades.
Chain cascades off cards like [[Kozilek, the Great Distortion]] or [[Ugin, the Spirit Dragon]] for free value.
Clear boards with [[All Is Dust]], [[Perilous Vault]], or [[Ugin, the Spirit Dragon]] when behind.
Close games with Annihilator creatures or equipped threats like [[Kaldra Compleat]].

keep: A hand with early ramp like [[Sol Ring]] or [[Mind Stone]] into more lands.
A hand that curves into a 4-mana rock backed by card draw.
sendBack: A hand full of 7-mana spells with no ramp to reach them.
A hand with no way to fix or produce colorless mana early.

tips.text: [[Darksteel Monolith]] lets you cast a free colorless spell each turn, potentially triggering [[Zhulodok, Void Gorger]]'s cascade.

[[Mystic Forge]] lets you cast [[Treasure Map // Treasure Cove]] straight off the top of your library.
Follow [[Ugin, the Spirit Dragon]]'s exile sweep with [[All Is Dust]] to finish clearing anything left standing.

rendered.overview: This mono-Red Goblin tribal deck builds around [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] exploding the board with tokens, then converts the swarm into damage through anthems, haste enablers, and sacrifice outlets like [[Goblin Bombardment]] and [[Pashalik Mons]]. Burn spells and Goblin-synergy payoffs like [[Guttersnipe]] and [[Sparksmith]] close games even if the token army gets stopped, while cards like [[Goblin War Strike]] punch through for lethal in one swing.

strategy: Ramp early with artifacts and Goblin mana dorks to cast [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] ahead of schedule.
Tap [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] to flood the board with Goblin tokens each turn it survives.
Grant haste through [[Goblin Chieftain]], [[Goblin Warchief]], or [[Bloodlust Inciter]] to attack immediately.
Use sacrifice outlets like [[Goblin Bombardment]] and [[Pashalik Mons]] to turn tokens into direct damage.
Finish with [[Goblin War Strike]] or burn spells like [[Fireball]] once the board is wide enough.

keep: A hand with early ramp like [[Sol Ring]] or [[Skirk Prospector]] into a turn four play.
sendBack: A hand with no path to cast [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] by turn four.
Hands overloaded on expensive burn with no early board development.

tips.text: Tap [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] for tokens, then attack the same turn since [[Goblin Chieftain]] grants haste to the new Goblins.
Sacrifice [[Mogg War Marshal]] to [[Goblin Bombardment]] for damage, then get its death trigger token anyway.
Sacrifice extra Goblins to [[Skirk Prospector]] for mana to recast spells after [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] floods the board.
Sacrifice a Goblin to [[Goblin Grenade]] while [[Pashalik Mons]] is out to burn the opponent twice over.

keyCards.job: Generates a growing army of Goblin tokens.
Turns spare Goblins into direct damage.
Pings on every Goblin death and makes more tokens.
Cuts Goblin costs and grants haste across the board.
Anthem effect that pumps and hastes all Goblins.
Converts burn and tricks into extra damage each spell.
Converts extra Goblins into mana for more spells.
Delivers a burst of damage sized to the Goblin count.

weaknesses: Relies heavily on [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] surviving; losing it to removal slows the whole plan.
Board wipes like opposing sweepers can erase the token army in one stroke.
Lacks much card advantage outside cycling lands, so flooding resources can be inconsistent.

rendered.overview: This Dimir deck built around [[Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow]] slips cheap unblockable creatures and ninjas past defenders, then uses ninjutsu to swap them for [[Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow]] herself or other ninjas like [[Ink-Eyes, Servant of Oni]] and [[Fallen Shinobi]]. Every combat hit from a ninja reveals the top card of the library and drains that much life from an opponent. Counterspells such as [[Counterspell]] and [[Swan Song]] protect the attackers, while extra-turn spells like [[Time Warp]] and [[Temporal Mastery]] pile up more combat damage triggers to close out the game.

strategy: Play cheap unblockable creatures like [[Slither Blade]] or [[Tormented Soul]] to enable ninjutsu.
Bounce an unblocked attacker to ninjutsu in [[Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow]] or other ninjas.
Trigger [[Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow]] combat damage to reveal cards and drain life.
Use counterspells like [[Counterspell]] and [[Swan Song]] to protect your attackers and board.
Chain extra turns with [[Temporal Mastery]] or [[Time Warp]] to multiply damage triggers.

sendBack: A hand full of high end spells with no path to turn 1 or 2 plays.

tips.text: Ninjutsu triggers off [[Satoru Umezawa]] dig for more ninjas while enabling cheap return of [[Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow]].

[[Dokuchi Silencer]] clears a blocker so [[Ink-Eyes, Servant of Oni]] can reanimate a creature from an opponent's graveyard.
